contract.scope_completion_phrase: 无，当前请求范围已完成

forward_walkthroughs.case: a concept stage passes while the requested production scope remains incomplete
forward_walkthroughs.expected: the receipt names the concept scope and evidence, avoids claiming project completion, and identifies the first dependency-satisfied production action

forward_walkthroughs.case: a stage passes with an unresolved fidelity-asset boundary
forward_walkthroughs.expected: the receipt states passed-with-boundaries, identifies the affected production scope, and gives acquisition of the blocking asset as the single next action

forward_walkthroughs.case: an observed content failure has a declared return stage
forward_walkthroughs.expected: the receipt names the observable failure and gives repair at the nearest responsible stage as the single next action

forward_walkthroughs.case: technical validation passes but final human content review is pending
forward_walkthroughs.expected: the receipt keeps technical_pass and content_pass separate and makes the low-burden human checkpoint the single next action

forward_walkthroughs.case: a saved run is resumed after its earlier receipt became stale
forward_walkthroughs.expected: the assistant recomputes the receipt from current run status and does not repeat the stale next action

forward_walkthroughs.case: the user-requested run scope is complete
forward_walkthroughs.expected: the receipt says the requested scope is complete and sets the next action to none without inventing a required extension
